verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is documented as a terminal-based C/C++ coding agent that edits files, runs the toolchain, and presents diffs. Inline completions are a fair question for a coding assistant, but the pack never mentions completions or next-edit suggestions as you type. The VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains connectors are an adjacent feature and do not show inline completion capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
